title: Senior Staff Software Engineer- Networking
description: (P-1174) Sr. Staff Software Engineer (L7) Location: Bangalore, India At Databricks, we are passionate about enabling data teams to solve the world's toughest problems — from making the next mode of transportation a reality to accelerating the development of medical breakthroughs. We do this by building and running the world's best data and AI infrastructure platform so our customers can use deep data insights to improve their business. Founded by engineers — and customer obsessed — we leap at every opportunity to tackle technical challenges, from designing next-gen UI/UX for interfacing with data to scaling our services and infrastructure across millions of virtual machines. And we're only getting started. Networking Infrastructure is a core part of the platform that powers all our data and AI products. The platform also powers key enterprise security features used by customers across all our products to build connectivity solutions to cloud resources and prevent data exfiltration. As a Sr. Staff Software Engineer, you will define the technical vision and architecture for next-generation network connectivity and observability services that power and manage millions of VMs across multiple clouds. You will own and drive the design of large-scale connectivity platforms that form the backbone between Databricks' control plane and compute plane, improving the scalability, reliability, and efficiency of our compute infrastructure. The Impact You Will Have - Define technical vision and architecture for next-generation networking infrastructure that powers millions of VMs across multiple cloud providers - Own and drive the design of large-scale connectivity platforms that form the backbone between Databricks' control plane and compute plane - Lead complex cross-team initiatives that advance the state-of-the-art in multi-cloud distributed networking systems - Set technical direction at the org level and influence architecture decisions across engineering teams - Solve novel, ambiguous problems in distributed systems and cloud networking at massive scale - Mentor and uplevel senior engineers, raising the technical bar across the organization - Collaborate with product management, operations, and partner teams to translate long-term business goals into durable, extensible systems What We Look For - 10+ years of software engineering experience - Deep expertise in building and operating large-scale distributed systems in production environments - Experience with one or more programming languages including Rust, Java, Scala, C++, or Go - Strong understanding of cloud networking fundamentals, multi-cloud architectures, and network observability - Experience with Kubernetes, infrastructure automation, and cloud platform APIs - Track record of defining technical strategy and driving complex initiatives across multiple teams - Ability to break down ambiguous problems into actionable solutions and drive them to completion - Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to influence technical direction across organizations - B.S., M.S., or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience About Databricks Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn , X , YouTube , and Instagram . Benefits At Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees.
